author: fieldmap
note: A CASE SET BUILT FOR MARGIN, NOT JUST FOR UNIQUENESS. Every earlier arity-1 batch used sixteen values, twelve of them half bit patterns - which as f32 are tiny POSITIVE denormals, where truncation and flooring and rounding all return zero. That is why the f32 rounding family's fits rest on ONE case of sixteen and why op3770 `rint` and op3786 `floor` returned identical vectors. Measured across the whole census: 29 of 66 unique fits have a nearest rival differing on a single case. These 31 values are the union of half-meaningful, f32-meaningful and low-bit-pattern inputs, and the worst-case margin between ANY two candidates is now 5 cases in float, 4 in half and 2 in integer, where all three were 1. Every candidate of every interpretation still gives a distinct answer vector - verified immediately before this file was written. No expect field: elimination. WHAT IS STILL NOT OFFERED: a third operand or an immediate this record does not vary, cross-lane behaviour (this harness gives every lane the same value), and any function of the destination's prior contents.

That is why the f32 rounding family's fits rest on ONE case of sixteen and why op3770 `rint` and op3786 `floor` returned identical vectors. Measured across the whole census: 29 of 66 unique fits have a nearest rival differing on a single case. These 31 values are the union of half-meaningful, f32-meaningful and low-bit-pattern inputs, and the worst-case margin between ANY two candidates is now 5 cases in float, 4 in half and 2 in integer, where all three were 1. Every candidate of every interpretation still gives a distinct answer vector - verified immediately before this file was written. No expect field: elimination. WHAT IS STILL NOT OFFERED: a third operand or an immediate this record does not vary, cross-lane behaviour (this harness gives every lane the same value), and any function of the destination's prior contents.
